Meme Generator

Make classic memes in seconds: upload a photo or start from a blank background, add top and bottom captions in bold meme style, and download as a PNG.

😂 Drop a photo here or click to browse (optional)

Live preview — every keystroke updates the meme. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload a photo, or leave it empty and pick a background color for a plain meme.
  2. Type your TOP TEXT and BOTTOM TEXT captions.
  3. Adjust the font size slider and text color — the preview updates live.
  4. Click “Download meme” to save it as a PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I make a meme without uploading a photo?

Yes — leave the image empty and pick any background color. You get a plain square canvas with your top and bottom captions.

Why is the text white with a black outline?

Classic meme text is white with a thick black outline, which stays readable on any background. You can change the fill color if you like.

Is my photo uploaded?

No. The meme is drawn on a canvas in your browser and downloaded directly — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
